intro: In an indirect question of yes / no, ли appears after the verb:

bloques.titulo: In an indirect question of yes / no, ли appears after the verb:
texto: In an indirect question of yes / no, ли appears after the verb:
The indirect question is integrated into the prayer and is usually separated with a coma; it does not keep the direct interrogative order.

frases.es: Preguntó si la sala estaba libre.
frases.en: He asked if the room was free.

frases.ru: Я не знаю, успеет ли поезд.
frases.es: No sé si el tren llegará a tiempo.
frases.en: I don't know if the train will be here in time.

bloques.pregunta: What word here marks an indirect question of yes / no?

opciones.explicacion: Ли goes after the verb and expresses the alternative yes / no.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.

opciones.texto: He asked if the room was free.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: I don't know if the train will be here in time.
opciones.explicacion: That's the translation of the second example.

bloques.frase: Я не знаю, успеет ли поезд
bloques.traduccion: I don't know if the train will be here in time.
bloques.explicacion: Look at the order of words and the outstanding grammatical form.
